Taa Seen Meem
Yeh Kitaab-e-Mubeen ki aayatein hain
Hum aap ko Moosa aur Fir'aun ki sachchi khabar suna rahe hain un logon ke liye jo imaan laane waale hain

Fir'aun ne roo-e-zameen par bulandi ikhtiyaar ki aur us ne ahl-e-zameen ko mukhtalif hisson mein taqseem kar diya, ke ek giroh ne doosre ko bilkul kamzor bana diya. Woh ladkon ko zibah kar diya karta tha aur auraton ko zinda rakha karta tha. Woh yaqeenan mufsideen mein se tha
Aur hum yeh chaahte hain ke jin logon ko zameen mein kamzor bana diya gaya hai un par ehsaan karein, aur inhein logon ka peshwa banaayein aur zameen ka waaris qaraar de dein
Aur unhi ko roo-e-zameen ka iqtidaar dein, aur Fir'aun o Haamaan aur un ke lashkaron ko unhi kamzoron ke haathon se woh manzar dikhlaayein jis se yeh dar rahe hain

Aur hum ne maadar-e-Moosa ki taraf wahi ki ke apne bachche ko doodh pilaao, aur us ke baad jab us ki zindagi ka khauf paida ho to use darya mein daal do, aur bilkul daro nahin aur pareshaan na ho, ke hum use tumhaari taraf palta dene waale aur use mursaleen mein se qaraar dene waale hain
Phir Fir'aun waalon ne use utha liya ke anjaam-e-kaar un ka dushman aur un ke liye baais-e-ranj o alam bane. Beshak Fir'aun aur Haamaan aur un ke lashkar waale sab ghalati par the

Aur Fir'aun ki zauja ne kaha ke yeh to hamaari aur tumhaari aankhon ki thandak hai, lihaaza ise qatl na karo, ke shaayad yeh humein faaida pahunchaaye aur hum ise apna farzand bana lein, aur woh log kuch nahin samajh rahe the
Aur Moosa ki maa ka dil bilkul khaali ho gaya, ke qareeb tha ke woh is raaz ko faash kar deteen agar hum un ke dil ko mutma'in na bana dete, taake woh imaan laane waalon mein shaamil ho jaayein
Aur unhon ne apni behan se kaha ke tum bhi in ka peechha karo, to unhon ne door se Moosa ko dekha jab ke un logon ko is ka ehsaas bhi nahin tha

Aur hum ne Moosa par doodh pilaane waaliyon ka doodh pehle hi se haraam kar diya, to Moosa ki behan ne kaha ke kya main tumhein aise ghar waalon ka pata bataaoon jo is ki kafaalat kar sakein aur woh is ke khair-khwaah bhi hon

Phir hum ne Moosa ko un ki maa ki taraf palta diya taake un ki aankh thandi ho jaaye aur woh pareshaan na rahein, aur inhein maaloom ho jaaye ke Allah ka waada bahar-haal sachcha hai, agarche logon ki aksariyat use nahin jaanti hai
Aur jab Moosa jawaani ki tawaanaaiyon ko pahunche aur tandurust ho gaye to hum ne inhein ilm aur hikmat ata kar di, aur hum isi tarah nek amal waalon ko jaza diya karte hain

Aur Moosa shehar mein us waqt daakhil hue jab log ghaflat ki neend mein the, to unhon ne do aadmiyon ko ladte hue dekha, ek un ke Shi'on mein se tha aur ek dushmanon mein se. To jo un ke Shi'on mein se tha us ne dushman ke zulm ki faryaad ki, to Moosa ne use ek ghoonsa maar kar us ki zindagi ka faisla kar diya, aur kaha ke yeh yaqeenan Shaitaan ke amal se tha, aur yaqeenan Shaitaan dushman aur khula hua gumraah karne waala hai
Moosa ne kaha ke Parwardigar! Main ne apne nafs ke liye museebat mol le li, lihaaza mujhe maaf kar de, to Parwardigar ne maaf kar diya ke woh bahut bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai
Moosa ne kaha ke Parwardigar! Tu ne meri madad ki hai, lihaaza main kabhi mujrimon ka saathi nahin banoonga

Phir subah ke waqt Moosa shehar mein daakhil hue to khaufzada aur haalaat ki nigraani karte hue, ke achaanak dekha ke jis ne kal madad ke liye pukaara tha woh phir faryaad kar raha hai. Moosa ne kaha ke yaqeenan tu khula hua gumraah hai

Phir jab Moosa ne chaaha ke us par hamla-aawar hon jo dono ka dushman hai to us ne kaha ke Moosa! Tum isi tarah mujhe qatl karna chaahte ho jis tarah tum ne kal ek be-gunaah ko qatl kiya hai? Tum sirf roo-e-zameen mein sarkash haakim ban kar rehna chaahte ho aur yeh nahin chaahte ho ke tumhaara shumaar islaah karne waalon mein ho

Aur idhar aakhir-e-shehar se ek shakhs daudta hua aaya aur us ne kaha ke Moosa! Shehar ke bade log baahami mashwara kar rahe hain ke tumhein qatl kar dein, lihaaza tum shehar se baahar nikal jaao, main tumhaare liye naseehat karne waalon mein se hoon
To Moosa shehar se baahar nikle khaufzada aur daayein baayein dekhte hue, aur kaha ke Parwardigar! Mujhe zaalim qaum se mahfooz rakhna
Aur jab Moosa ne Madyan ka rukh kiya to kaha ke anqareeb Parwardigar mujhe seedhe raaste ki hidaayat kar dega

Aur jab Madyan ke chashme par waarid hue to logon ki ek jamaa'at ko dekha jo jaanwaron ko paani pila rahi thi, aur un se alag do auratein thin jo jaanwaron ko roke khadi thin. Moosa ne poochha ke tum logon ka kya mas'ala hai? Un dono ne kaha ke hum us waqt tak paani nahin pilaate hain jab tak saari qaum hat na jaaye, aur hamaare baaba ek za'eef-ul-umr aadmi hain
Moosa ne dono ke jaanwaron ko paani pila diya aur phir ek saaye mein aa kar panaah le li. Arz ki: Parwardigar! Yaqeenan main us khair ka muhtaaj hoon jo tu meri taraf bhej de

Itne mein dono mein se ek ladki kamaal-e-sharm o haya ke saath chalti hui aayi aur us ne kaha ke mere baaba aap ko bula rahe hain ke aap ke paani pilaane ki ujrat de dein. Phir jo Moosa un ke paas aaye aur apna qissa bayaan kiya to unhon ne kaha ke daro nahin, ab tum zaalim qaum se najaat pa gaye
Un dono mein se ek ladki ne kaha ke baaba! Aap inhein naukar rakh lijiye, ke aap jise bhi naukar rakhna chaahein un mein sab se behtar woh hoga jo saahib-e-quwwat bhi ho aur amaanat-daar bhi ho

Unhon ne kaha ke main in dono mein se ek beti ka aqd aap se karna chaahta hoon ba-shart-e-ke aap aath saal tak meri khidmat karein, phir agar das saal poore kar dein to yeh aap ki taraf se hoga, aur main aap ko koi zahmat nahin dena chaahta hoon. In-sha-Allah aap mujhe nek bandon mein se paayenge
Moosa ne kaha ke yeh mere aur aap ke darmiyaan ka mu'aahida hai. Main jo muddat bhi poori kar doon mere oopar koi zimmedaari nahin hogi, aur main jo kuch bhi keh raha hoon Allah us ka gawaah hai

Phir jab Moosa muddat ko poora kar chuke aur apne ahl ko le kar chale to Toor ki taraf se ek aag nazar aayi. Unhon ne apne ahl se kaha ke tum log thehro, main ne ek aag dekhi hai, shaayad us mein se koi khabar le aaoon ya koi chingaari hi le aaoon ke tum log us se taapne ka kaam le sako
Phir jo us aag ke qareeb aaye to waadi ke daahine rukh se ek mubaarak maqaam par ek darakht se aawaaz aayi ke Moosa! Main aalameen ka paalne waala Khuda hoon

Aur tum apne asa ko zameen par daal do. Aur jo Moosa ne dekha to woh saanp ki tarah lehra raha tha. Yeh dekh kar Moosa peechhe hat gaye aur phir mud kar bhi na dekha, to phir aawaaz aayi ke Moosa! Aage badho aur daro nahin, ke tum bilkul maamoon o mahfooz ho

Zara apne haath ko girebaan mein daakhil karo, woh baghair kisi beemaari ke safed aur chamakdaar ban kar baraamad hoga, aur khauf se apne baazuon ko apni taraf samet lo. Tumhaare liye Parwardigar ki taraf se Fir'aun aur us ki qaum ke sardaaron ki taraf yeh do daleelein hain, ke yeh log sab faasiq aur badkaar hain
Moosa ne kaha ke Parwardigar! Main ne un ke ek aadmi ko maar daala hai to mujhe khauf hai ke yeh mujhe qatl kar denge aur kaar-e-tableegh ruk jaaega
Aur mere bhai Haaroon mujh se zyaada faseeh zabaan ke maalik hain, lihaaza unhein mere saath madadgaar bana de jo meri tasdeeq kar sakein, ke main darta hoon ke kahin yeh log meri takzeeb na kar dein

Irshaad hua ke hum tumhaare baazuon ko tumhaare bhai se mazboot kar denge, aur tumhaare liye aisa ghalaba qaraar denge ke yeh log tum tak pahunch hi na sakein, aur hamaari nishaaniyon ke sahaare tum aur tumhaare pairokaar hi ghaalib rahenge

Phir jab Moosa un ke paas hamaari khuli hui nishaaniyaan le kar aaye to un logon ne keh diya ke yeh to sirf ek gadha hua jaadoo hai, aur hum ne apne guzashta buzurgon se is tarah ki koi baat nahin suni hai
Aur Moosa ne kaha ke mera Parwardigar behtar jaanta hai ke kaun us ki taraf se hidaayat le kar aaya hai aur kis ke liye aakhirat ka ghar hai, yaqeenan zaalimeen ke liye falaah nahin hai

Aur Fir'aun ne kaha ke mere zu'ama-e-mamlakat! Mere ilm mein tumhaare liye mere ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, lihaaza Haamaan! Tum mere liye mitti ka pajaawa lagaao aur phir ek qila tayyaar karo ke main us par chadh kar Moosa ke Khuda ki khabar le aaoon, aur mera khayaal to yahi hai ke Moosa jhoote hain
Aur Fir'aun aur us ke lashkar ne na-haq ghuroor se kaam liya aur yeh khayaal kar liya ke woh palta kar hamaari baargaah mein nahin laaye jaayenge
To hum ne Fir'aun aur us ke lashkaron ko apni giraft mein le liya aur sab ko darya mein daal diya, to dekho ke zaalimeen ka anjaam kaisa hota hai
Aur hum ne un logon ko Jahannam ki taraf daawat dene waala peshwa qaraar de diya hai, aur qiyaamat ke din un ki koi madad nahin ki jaaegi
Aur duniya mein bhi hum ne un ke peechhe la'nat ko laga diya hai, aur qiyaamat ke din bhi un ka shumaar un logon mein hoga jin ke chehre bigaad diye jaayenge
Aur hum ne pehli naslon ko halaak kar dene ke baad Moosa ko kitaab ata ki jo logon ke liye baseerat ka saamaan aur hidaayat o rehmat hai, aur shaayad isi tarah yeh log naseehat haasil kar lein
Aur aap us waqt Toor ke maghribi rukh par na the jab hum ne Moosa ki taraf apna hukm bheja, aur aap is waaqe ke haazireen mein se bhi nahin the

Lekin hum ne bahut si qaumon ko paida kiya, phir un par ek taweel zamaana guzar gaya, aur aap to ahl-e-Madyan mein bhi muqeem nahin the ke inhein hamaari aayatein padh kar sunaate, lekin hum rasool banaane waale to the

Aur aap Toor ke kisi jaanib us waqt nahin the jab hum ne Moosa ko aawaaz di, lekin aap ke Parwardigar ki rehmat hai ke aap us qaum ko daraayein jis ki taraf aap se pehle koi paighambar nahin aaya hai, ke shaayad woh is tarah ibrat aur naseehat haasil kar lein

Aur agar aisa na hota ke jab un par guzashta aamaal ki bina par koi museebat naazil hoti to yahi kehte ke Parwardigar! Tu ne hamaari taraf koi rasool kyon nahin bheja hai ke hum teri nishaaniyon ki pairwi karte aur saahibaan-e-imaan mein shaamil ho jaate

Phir us ke baad jab hamaari taraf se haq aa gaya to kehne lage ke inhein woh sab kyon nahin diya gaya hai jo Moosa ko diya gaya tha? To kya un logon ne is se pehle Moosa ka inkaar nahin kiya, aur ab to kehte hain ke Tauraat aur Quran jaadoo hain jo ek doosre ki taaeed karte hain, aur hum dono hi ka inkaar karne waale hain
To aap keh dijiye ke achchha tum Parwardigar ki taraf se koi kitaab le aao jo dono se zyaada saheeh ho aur main us ka ittibaa' kar loon, agar tum apni baat mein sachche ho

Phir agar qubool na karein to samajh lijiye ke yeh sirf apni khwaahishaat ka ittibaa' karne waale hain, aur us se zyaada gumraah kaun hai jo Khudaai hidaayat ke baghair apni khwaahishaat ka ittibaa' kar le, jab ke Allah zaalim qaum ki hidaayat karne waala nahin hai
Aur hum ne musalsal un logon tak apni baatein pahunchaayin ke shaayad isi tarah naseehat haasil kar lein
Jin logon ko hum ne is se pehle kitaab di hai woh is Quran par imaan rakhte hain
Aur jab un ke saamne is ki tilaawat ki jaati hai to kehte hain ke hum imaan le aaye, yeh hamaare Rab ki taraf se barhaq hai, aur hum to pehle hi se tasleem kiye hue the
Yahi woh log hain jin ko dohri jaza di jaaegi, ke unhon ne sabr kiya hai, aur yeh nekiyon ke zariye buraaiyon ko dafa karte hain, aur hum ne jo rizq diya hai us mein se kharch karte hain

Aur jab laghw baat sunte hain to kinaara-kashi ikhtiyaar karte hain aur kehte hain ke hamaare liye hamaare aamaal hain aur tumhaare liye tumhaare aamaal hain, tum par hamaara salaam ke hum jaahilon ki sohbat pasand nahin karte hain
Paighambar! Beshak aap jise chaahein use hidaayat nahin de sakte hain, balke Allah jise chaahta hai hidaayat de deta hai, aur woh un logon se khoob baakhabar hai jo hidaayat paane waale hain

Aur yeh kuffaar kehte hain ke hum aap ke saath haq ki pairwi karenge to apni zameen se uchak liye jaayenge. To kya hum ne inhein ek mahfooz Haram par qabza nahin diya hai jis ki taraf har shai ke phal hamaari di hui rozi ki bina par chale aa rahe hain? Lekin un ki aksariyat samajhti hi nahin hai

Aur hum ne kitni hi bastiyon ko un ki ma'eeshat ke ghuroor ki bina par halaak kar diya. Ab yeh un ke makaanaat hain jo un ke baad phir aabaad na ho sake magar bahut kam, aur dar-haqeeqat hum hi har cheez ke waaris aur maalik hain

Aur aap ka Parwardigar kisi basti ko halaak karne waala nahin hai jab tak ke us ke markaz mein koi rasool na bhej de jo un ke saamne hamaari aayaat ki tilaawat kare, aur hum kisi basti ke tabaah karne waale nahin hain magar yeh ke us ke rehne waale zaalim hon

Aur jo kuch bhi tumhein ata kiya gaya hai yeh chand-roza lazzat-e-duniya aur zeenat-e-duniya hai, aur jo kuch bhi Khuda ki baargaah mein hai woh khair aur baaqi rehne waala hai. Kya tum itna bhi nahin samajhte ho

Kya woh banda jis se hum ne behtareen waada kiya hai aur woh use pa bhi lega, us ke maanind hai jise hum ne duniya mein thodi si lazzat de di hai, aur phir woh roz-e-qiyaamat Khuda ki baargaah mein kheench kar haazir kiya jaaega
Jis din Khuda un logon ko aawaaz dega ke mere woh shuraka kahaan hain jin ki shirkat ka tumhein khayaal tha

To jin shuraka par azaab saabit ho chuka hoga woh kahenge ke Parwardigar! Yeh hain woh log jin ko hum ne gumraah kiya hai, aur isi tarah gumraah kiya hai jis tarah hum khud gumraah hue the, lekin ab un se baraa'at chaahte hain, yeh hamaari ibaadat to nahin kar rahe the
To kaha jaaega ke achchha apne shuraka ko pukaaro. To woh pukaarenge lekin koi jawaab na paayenge, balke azaab hi ko dekhenge. To kaash yeh duniya hi mein hidaayat-yaafta ho jaate
Aur jis din Khuda un se pukaar kar kahega ke tum ne hamaare rasoolon ko kya jawaab diya tha
To un par saari khabrein taareek ho jaayengi aur woh aapas mein ek doosre se sawaal bhi na kar sakenge
Lekin jis ne tauba kar li aur imaan le aaya aur nek amal kiya woh yaqeenan falaah paane waalon mein shumaar ho jaaega
Aur aap ka Parwardigar jise chaahta hai paida karta hai aur pasand karta hai. Un logon ko kisi ka intikhaab karne ka koi haq nahin hai. Khuda un ke shirk se paak aur buland o bartar hai
Aur aap ka Parwardigar un cheezon ko bhi jaanta hai jo yeh apne seenon mein chhupaaye hue hain, aur unhein bhi jaanta hai jin ka yeh e'laan o izhaar karte hain
Woh Allah hai jis ke ilaawa koi doosra khuda nahin hai, aur awwal o aakhir aur duniya o aakhirat mein saari hamd usi ke liye hai, usi ke liye hukm hai aur usi ki taraf tum sab ko waapas jaana padega

Aap kahiye ke tumhaara kya khayaal hai agar Khuda tumhaare liye raat ko qiyaamat tak ke liye abadi bana de to kya us ke ilaawa aur koi ma'bood hai jo tumhaare liye raushni ko le aa sake? To kya tum baat sunte nahin ho
Aur kahiye ke agar woh din ko qiyaamat tak ke liye daaimi bana de to us ke ilaawa kaun ma'bood hai jo tumhaare liye woh raat le aaega jis mein sukoon haasil kar sako? Kya tum dekhte nahin ho
Yeh us ki rehmat ka ek hissa hai ke us ne tumhaare liye raat aur din dono banaaye hain taake aaraam bhi kar sako aur rizq bhi talaash kar sako, aur shaayad us ka shukriya bhi ada kar sako
Aur qiyaamat ke din Khuda inhein aawaaz dega ke mere woh shareek kahaan hain jin ki shirkat ka tumhein khayaal tha

Aur hum har qaum mein se ek gawaah nikaal kar laayenge aur munkireen se kahenge ke tum bhi apni daleel le aao. Tab inhein maaloom hoga ke haq Allah hi ke liye hai, aur phir woh jo iftira-pardaaziyaan kiya karte the woh sab gum ho jaayengi

Beshak Qaaroon Moosa ki qaum mein se tha magar us ne qaum par zulm kiya, aur hum ne bhi use itne khazaane de diye the ke ek taaqatwar jamaa'at se bhi us ki kunjiyaan nahin uth sakti thin. Phir jab us se qaum ne kaha ke is qadar na itraao ke Khuda itraane waalon ko dost nahin rakhta hai

Aur jo kuch Khuda ne diya hai us se aakhirat ke ghar ka intezaam karo, aur duniya mein apna hissa bhool na jaao, aur neki karo jis tarah ke Khuda ne tumhaare saath nek bartaao kiya hai, aur zameen mein fasaad ki koshish na karo ke Allah fasaad karne waalon ko dost nahin rakhta hai

Qaaroon ne kaha ke mujhe yeh sab kuch mere ilm ki bina par diya gaya hai. To kya use yeh maaloom nahin hai ke Allah ne us se pehle bahut si naslon ko halaak kar diya hai jo us se zyaada taaqatwar aur maal ke etibaar se daulatmand thin? Aur aise mujrimon se to un ke gunaahon ke baare mein sawaal bhi nahin kiya jaata hai

Phir Qaaroon apni qaum ke saamne zeb o zeenat ke saath baraamad hua to jin logon ke dil mein zindagaani-e-duniya ki khwaahish thi unhon ne kehna shuroo kar diya ke kaash hamaare paas bhi yeh saaz o saamaan hota jo Qaaroon ko diya gaya hai, yeh to bade azeem hisse ka maalik hai

Aur jinhein ilm diya gaya tha unhon ne kaha ke afsos tumhaare haal par! Allah ka sawaab saahibaan-e-imaan o amal-e-saaleh ke liye is se kahin zyaada behtar hai, aur woh sawaab sabr karne waalon ke ilaawa kisi ko nahin diya jaata hai
Phir hum ne use aur us ke ghar-baar ko zameen mein dhansa diya, aur na koi giroh Khuda ke ilaawa bachaane waala paida hua aur na woh khud apna bachaao karne waala tha

Aur jin logon ne kal us ki jagah ki tamanna ki thi woh kehne lage ke Ma'aaz-Allah! Yeh to Khuda jis bande ke liye chaahta hai us ke rizq mein wus'at paida kar deta hai aur jis ke yahaan chaahta hai tangi paida kar deta hai, aur agar us ne hum par ehsaan na kar diya hota to humein bhi dhansa diya hota. Ma'aaz-Allah! Kaafiron ke liye waaqai falaah nahin hai
Yeh daar-e-aakhirat woh hai jise hum un logon ke liye qaraar dete hain jo zameen mein bulandi aur fasaad ke talabgaar nahin hote hain, aur aaqibat to sirf saahibaan-e-taqwa ke liye hai
Jo koi neki karega use us se behtar ajr milega, aur jo koi buraai karega to buraai karne waalon ko utni hi saza di jaaegi jaise aamaal woh karte rahe hain

Beshak jis ne aap par Quran ka fareeza aaid kiya hai woh aap ko aap ki manzil tak zaroor waapas pahunchaaega. Aap keh dijiye ke mera Parwardigar behtar jaanta hai ke kaun hidaayat le kar aaya hai aur kaun khuli hui gumraahi mein hai
Aur aap to is baat ke umeedwaar nahin the ke aap ki taraf kitaab naazil ki jaaye, yeh to rehmat-e-Parwardigar hai, lihaaza khabardaar aap kaafiron ka saath na dijiyega
Aur hargiz yeh log aayaat ke naazil hone ke baad un ki tableegh se aap ko rokne na paayein, aur aap apne Rab ki taraf daawat dijiye aur khabardaar mushrikeen mein se na ho jaaiye
Aur Allah ke saath kisi doosre khuda ko mat pukaaro ke us ke ilaawa koi ma'bood nahin hai. Us ki zaat ke maasiwa har shai halaak hone waali hai, aur tum sab usi ki baargaah ki taraf palataaye jaaoge
